name: Disable adapter
description: Disables an active adapter on the running venue: retracts its catalog operations and v/info/adapters entry and stops dispatch. Kernel adapters (covia, agent, dlfs, hitl, http, file, grid, venue) cannot be disabled. In-flight jobs finish on the retained instance. Idempotent; not persisted across restarts. Venue-owned: requires adapter/manage on <venue DID>/adapters.
